purpose: Post-hoc train-only diagnosis of the frozen v18 B checkpoint after v19. Measure family-gradient compatibility and low/mid/high spatial-band plus late-time safety before choosing the next training lever.
claim_scope: exploratory diagnostic only; not a promotion stage; v19 records are already consumed and may not be reused as an independent gate for a modified candidate
truth_scope: 24 train/final_train_confirm records already opened by v19; validation and test_id remain sealed

frozen_readout.gradient_conflict: A family pair is conflicting if cosine < -0.1, weakly aligned if -0.1 <= cosine <= 0.1, and compatible if cosine > 0.1.
frozen_readout.sampling_lever: Compare every family gradient's alignment with the fit2-proportional aggregate (1095 layered, 675 marmousi, 395 uniform) and an equal-family aggregate. Improved weak-family alignment under the equal aggregate supports a family-balanced sampling probe; negative pairwise conflict supports a family-specific head or conflict-aware optimizer probe.
frozen_readout.high_band_safety: Exploratory safety readout is mean high-band relative gain > 0 and candidate nonworse on at least 22/24 records.
frozen_readout.late_safety: Exploratory safety readout is mean late-third relative gain > 0 and candidate nonworse on at least 22/24 records.

prohibitions: no promotion claim from this post-hoc panel
